verdict.rationale: Riskified's REST API (pre-auth, post-auth sync and async flows) sits alongside whatever gateway authorizes the transaction rather than on one processor's rails. Chargeback gateway integrations cover Adyen, Stripe, Braintree and PayPal, and platform integrations exist for Shopify, SFCC and Magento. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of PSP/gateway agnosticism, documentation of running multiple PSPs at once for the same merchant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
